name: What is the typical process for installing custom baseboards?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for installing custom baseboards?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process for custom baseboards typically begins with precise measurements of the room. This is followed by cutting the chosen material to fit, including intricate miter cuts for corners. The baseboards are then securely fastened to the wall and finished with caulking and painting to ensure a seamless appearance. Maine Results, Inc. ensures a meticulous approach, handling all aspects from preparation to the final finish to deliver a clean and polished result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves precise measurement, cutting, fastening, and finishing with caulk and paint, ensuring a seamless and polished result.
